Niacinamide / 烟酰胺

Ingredient overview

Studied for visible uneven tone in specific formulations. The 2002 research included laboratory work and human comparisons. Those results are not a performance certificate for a new formula.

Read the sources

  • Niacinamide pigmentation study · Hakozaki et al., 2002Primary clinical and laboratory research
